cross_product_finding: MAIN FINDING (repeats across nearly every statement page in this batch): Capella's Prerequisites section does not use the server/-derived RBAC privilege vocabulary at all (no 'Query Manage Index'). Instead it branches on which of two 'cluster access credential types' the client authenticates with: Basic credentials require the 'Write' privilege; Advanced credentials require the 'Query Index' privilege. This is a different SHAPE of access model, not just a different privilege name - it's a 2-way conditional keyed on credential type rather than a single named privilege attached to the statement. I minted privilege:capella-basic-access-write and privilege:capella-advanced-access-query-index plus enum:cluster-access-credential-type rather than reusing privilege:query-manage-index, to avoid misrepresenting Capella's access model as identical to server/'s RBAC. SECOND FINDING (specific to this page): despite the batch framing that 'Capella has no discrete version numbers,' this page explicitly gates a feature by server version: 'In clusters running Couchbase Server 8.0 and later, the CREATE INDEX statement also allows you to create Composite Vector indexes.' It also gates WITH-clause 'nodes' placement behavior on 'Couchbase Server versions 7.6.0 and 7.6.1' vs '7.6.2 and later,' and links out to a server/ Rebalance page. Per instructions I have NOT minted version:server-8.0 or version:server-7.6.x concepts, since the batch instructions say to flag version-like content here rather than guess at a fit - but this strongly suggests the Capella docs content for this page was copied from server/ documentation without being fully adapted to Capella's continuously-deployed, version-less framing.
